query: What is the penalty for dual registration of same property?
reference_answer:
Dual Registration of Same Property:
The penalty can include imprisonment up to 7 years and/or a fine, under Section 467 of the IPC for forgery of valuable security, and also attract penalties under the Registration Act, 1908.
answer: Without evidence, I can't provide specific penalties. However, in many jurisdictions, dual registration of the same property for different purposes could lead to legal action and fines. [Document 1] provides details on such penalties.
